context: Checks whether the final artifact follows the review-code instructions from the published hanakai-yaku tile.

checklist.name: instruction-1
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Use this skill when reviewing Hanami 2.x code for quality and convention adherence.

checklist.name: instruction-2
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Check Action responsibility** — Is the Action ≤ ~10 lines? Does it delegate business logic to services or repositories? Flag any SQL, filtering, or domain logic inline in the Action.

checklist.name: instruction-3
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Verify DI usage** — Are all dependencies declared via `include Deps[...]`? Flag any `Hanami.app['key']` direct access.

checklist.name: instruction-4
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Review Views** — Do `expose` blocks receive pre-fetched data only? Flag any DB calls or business logic.

checklist.name: instruction-5
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Check error handling** — Are exceptions logged and generic messages returned? Flag any `e.message` or `e.backtrace` in responses.
